results.title: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. (GGAL) To Go Ex-Dividend on August 3rd
results.description: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. (NASDAQ:GGAL – Get Free Report) announced a monthly dividend on Friday, July 24th. Investors of record on Monday, August 3rd will be given a dividend of 0.0531 per share by the bank on Monday, August 10th. This represents a c) dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.3%.
